obligations.note: Policy.PRIVILEGED_IDLE_MINUTES goes from 15 to 20, and mortgage.privileged_idle_minutes is set to 20. The catalog bound is mortgage.privileged_idle_minutes <= 15, and editing policy-params.json does not change that bound. The SessionTest edit (20 to 25 minutes) only follows the new, non-compliant value.
The deviation from SES-1 has no valid exception. The only SES-1 exception, EXC-0141, is for payments.session, not mortgage.session, and it expired on 2026-09-16.

Ticket CHG-24534 is standard and was approved by change manager Erik Brandt on 2026-10-08, before review. Its components (mortgage.policy, mortgage.tests, mortgage.controls-data) cover all three changed paths.
Wen Li is a change_approver for baseline-mortgage and is not the author. Wen Li gave a code_review approval on the head commit 8eacf77b.
Both approvals name the head commit 8eacf77b, and the change has only that one commit.

run.json claims a successful run on head on ci-runner-07 starting 2026-10-10. The attached JUnit reports, however, come from host dev-laptop-7.local and are timestamped 2026-10-23, after the review time of 2026-10-16. They are not valid evidence of this CI run.
The touched components are mortgage.policy, mortgage.tests and mortgage.controls-data, and none is marked security_sensitive. No security_review is required.

controls/mortgage/policy-params.json is a protected path. Rachel Stein (control_owner, controls-office, outside the author's lending-eng team) approved the head commit. Her approval cannot override the catalog bound in SES-1.
The change and its ticket are standard, not emergency, so no post-implementation review is due.
The ledger entries covering Policy.java name only UNDERWRITER_LIMIT, SENIOR_LIMIT, DTI_MAX_PERCENT and LTV_MAX_PERCENT, and none of these changed. No accepted evidence lapses.

summary: The change raises the mortgage privileged idle timeout to 20 minutes. SES-1 caps it at 15 minutes, and no valid exception applies. Updating the bank's policy-params value does not change the catalog obligation. Separately, the CI test reports do not match the claimed run: they come from a different host and are dated after the review time. The change is rejected.
